## Asimetría y curtosis en R

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(42)

datos <- c(80, 85, 90, 92, 95, 98, 180)
df <- data.frame(precio = datos)

ggplot(df, aes(x = precio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 15, fill = "#dce9f7", color = "#1a3a6b", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(datos), color = "#c0392b", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(datos), color = "#1b4d2e", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(datos) + 3, y = 2.1,
           label = paste0("Media = ", round(mean(datos), 1)),
           color = "#c0392b", hjust = 0, size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = median(datos) - 3, y = 1.7,
           label = paste0("Mediana = ", median(datos)),
           color = "#1b4d2e", hjust = 1, size = 4.5) +
  labs(title = "Precios de predios rurales: sesgo positivo",
       x = "Precio (millones $)", y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
